itemized.notes: 8-page filing (James M. Winder / 'Jim Winder For Sheriff', period June 20 2006 - September 10 2006, Summary Page hand-dated 9/14/06). PAGE ORDER IS UNUSUAL AND THE SUMMARY PAGE IS LAST: p1 cover, p2 on-form Schedule A blank + 'See attached', pp.3-4 the Schedule A attachment (landscape, 'Page 1 of 2'/'Page 2 of 2'), p5 on-form Schedule B blank + 'See attached', pp.6-7 the Schedule B attachment (landscape), p8 the SUMMARY PAGE ('Page 8 of 8'). Anyone assuming page 2 is the Summary Page here would read a blank schedule. The attachments carry a 'Name Address' column that is EMPTY on every row but one (row 52 has the descriptor 'Personal Loan', not an address), so there is no donor city/state anywhere in this filing and none was invented. TYPE COLUMN: Schedule A's own 'Type' column distinguishes 'Contribution' (58 rows), '< $50' (1 aggregate line, no date and no name, $1,131.01) and 'In-Kind' (5 rows) - the In-Kind flag is taken from that column, and the same five in-kind items reappear on Schedule B with '(In-Kind)' in the Purpose cell. The candidate loaned his own campaign twice ($15,000 on 08/17 and $20,000 on 09/08, both marked 'Candidate Loan' in the Occupation column) - recorded as printed contributions because the schedule and its total treat them as such. EXPENDITURE SIGN: every Schedule B amount is printed with a leading minus and the attachment's own Total is -36,202.06, while the Summary Page states 36,202.06 positive - a column-wide accounting convention, so magnitudes are recorded and the convention is named on every row. One purpose reads 'Accounts Receivable' rather than 'Accounts Payable' (08/23 Bob Richer) - kept verbatim.
